title: Players
subtitle: Save preferred heroes for yourself and the friends you queue with.
emptyHint: Your preferred heroes boost recommendations. Add friends to get party combos.
name: Name
aliasesHint: If this player also plays on alt accounts, list those nicknames. The desktop app recognizes them on the scoreboard too. Separate several with commas.
preferredRolesHint: When a party member's role isn't fixed, recommendations stay within these roles. Picking all three is the same as Any.
preferredHint: Pick heroes you're good at or play often. They get a score bonus.
onlyPreferredHint: When on, party recommendations only suggest this person's preferred heroes. Toggle per match with ★ in the party bar.
guestNote: Guest: profiles are saved in this browser only.
